verdict.block: Stop the task for a person to decide
verdict.needs_more_turns: Run it again with more turns

delivery.queued: Waits for the running agent's next turn: {line}

outlived: {agent} finished in {stage} after the task moved to {now}; its result did not apply
deferred: {agent} waits for the agent of {busy} before starting in {stage}

skip.removed_back: {who} made {stage} run again, so the task goes back there: {reason}
skip.removed_later: {who} made {stage} run again; the task goes back there when the current run ends: {reason}
skip.ui_diff: {stage} runs after all: the branch changes UI files
skip.diff_unreadable: {stage} runs after all: the branch diff could not be read
skip.refinement_dropped: {stage} runs again: the refinement no longer skips it
skip.board_changed: The task no longer skips {stage}: it moved to another board
skip.passed_over: Passed over {stage}, which this task skips: {reason}

auditor_skipped: Audit of {agent} skipped in {stage}: no signals ({checks})
